name: Roya Kenriji
source:
He is the older brother of Junoru. His appearance resembles his brother, but looks messier. His uniform reveals that he attends the same school as our heroine, but she has never seen him around.

A flirtatious character, seems like a play boy. He has fun in giving nicknames, despite his brother's annoyance. After meeting the heroine, he takes an interest in her for more than personal reasons. His true intentions are unknown.

[From [url=https://darknights-time.weebly.com/roya.html]official site[/url]]
